bullets.text: In-Country Data Processing Expanded - **Microsoft** enhances data sovereignty for **Microsoft 365 Copilot** in 15 countries, including the **UK**.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - **Microsoft** unveils Insider Preview Build 28000, focusing on general improvements for **Windows 11** users.
New Side-Channel Attack Discovered - **Microsoft** reveals a novel cyberattack on language models, threatening user privacy despite encryption.
Azure Ultra Disk Enhancements - **Microsoft** announces updates to **Azure Ultra Disk**, improving performance and cost efficiency for critical workloads.
Leader in Application Streaming - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in IDC MarketScape for application streaming and enterprise browsers.
Cloud Security Shift Identified - New **IDC** research highlights a significant increase in cloud security incidents, urging a strategic rethink.
AI Foundry in Healthcare - **Microsoft** partners with **UiPath** to enhance healthcare workflows through AI and automation.
Generative AI for Security Operations - **Microsoft** introduces generative AI capabilities to improve efficiency in security operations centers.
Passkey Syncing in Edge - **Microsoft Edge** now supports passkey saving and syncing, enhancing online security for users.
New Backdoor Exploits OpenAI API - **Microsoft** uncovers a backdoor using the **OpenAI** API for command and control communications.
